name: type-explainer
about: A 20-30 s type-led explainer on a white page, one short sentence at a time: the name as one giant word with a band of the accent running through it and the mark arriving as the next word, what the product is said at the pace of speech, the problem as one drifting line, the promise with a picture inside it that grows into the next shot, the name over that picture, one soft wipe, how it fits together with the mark standing between the words, the mark becoming the hub of the product's parts, the close. new-film.sh --template type-explainer lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every explainer is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): a calm, even bed whose downbeats carry the act lines; earshot effects mark what lands (the name, each line when it is whole, the picture, the wipe, the parts); never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 85-105 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); 85-105 BPM, light and steady, suits one sentence a bar
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template type-explainer --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring
